title: A Large-scale Dataset for Hate Speech Detection on Vietnamese Social Media Texts
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical task of creating a dataset and benchmarking models for hate speech detection. While hate speech is an ethical issue and can target religious groups (mentioned in the annotation guidelines), the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical concepts themselves. It is an application of NLP for a safety/ethical purpose, not a study of ethics or faith.
